data.action: 单手将炽热的莱瓦汀巨剑扛在肩头，侧身回眸，身后火巨人暗影升腾
data.camera: low angle, wide shot, 仰视全景，突出巨剑、人物气场与背景巨神暗影
data.description: 古老萨卡兹火山遗迹的熔岩裂隙前，黑曜石在翻滚的地火下散发炽热幽芒。史尔特尔单手将魔剑‘莱瓦汀’扛在肩头，身后熔岩火巨人的轮廓在黑烟中若隐若现。她回眸注视着前方的道路，金红双眸倒映着滚烫的火光——「跟紧了，别被地火吞噬。」
data.lighting: 地表熔岩裂隙喷涌的橙红火光与暗黑焦岩对冲
data.location: 萨卡兹火山熔岩裂隙遗迹
data.promptProse: Amidst ancient volcanic ruins beside glowing molten fissures, Surtr stands resolute resting her blazing greatsword Laevateinn across one shoulder. Towering smoke and the silhouette of a colossal fire giant rise behind her, with vivid orange magma light illuminating obsidian rock and her intense gaze.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 熔岩遗迹的烈焰扛剑
data.animaCaption: Carrying her burning greatsword across one shoulder beside volcanic fissures, she looks forward as the fiery giant looms through the smoke.
